qualification: executor smoke plus upstream Workerd WPT baseline; not conformance
label: smoke-not-conformance

executor_policy_declarations.qualification: unverified policy declarations; API surface types are reported separately by the smoke response

outbound_fetch.blocking_gap: The trusted external Workerd-fork executor has no guest-to-host outbound fetch channel and its source is not vendored in this repository. Registering net_* alone would expose raw guest sockets without supplying Workerd Request/Response semantics.
required_bridge: Add an executor-side global fetch service that calls a typed host function rather than raw sockets.
Authorize from host-owned worker identity and an explicit scheme, host and port allowlist.
Resolve on the host, reject redirects outside the allowlist, private/local/metadata addresses unless separately opted in, and DNS rebinding.
Bound connect and total time, request and response body bytes, header count and bytes, redirects and concurrent requests.
Return validated protocol envelopes and cancel all in-flight work when the request VM is killed or dropped.
Test allowed loopback against an explicit test server, denied destinations, redirect denial, size and timeout limits, and fresh-VM isolation.

existing_host_primitives: per-request watchdog and fresh VM teardown
timers.blocking_gap: The external Workerd-fork executor does not expose its JSG timer channel. The host already parks and re-enters the VM for guest deadlines, but cannot create or cancel JavaScript timers on the executor's behalf.
required_bridge: Implement setTimeout and clearTimeout in the executor using its owner-thread event loop and the guest monotonic clock.
Cap timers per request and clamp maximum delay to the request deadline.
Cancel timer handles when fetch completes, the watchdog kills the VM, or the fresh VM is dropped.
Keep callback execution on the VM owner thread; cross-thread work may only signal that owner.
Test ordering, cancellation, delay bounds, timeout interruption and absence of timer state in the next fresh VM.

additional_workerd_baseline.reason: No dedicated timers WPT target is configured in src/wpt.
No dedicated WebAssembly WPT target is configured in src/wpt.
